title: Regular root-polytope triangulation realizes the twice-coned core of a dominant pipe-dream complex
author: Escobar, Laura; Mészáros, Karola
work: Subword complexes via triangulations of root polytopes
source_version: Algebraic Combinatorics 1 (2018), no.3,395-414; DOI10.5802/alco.17; publisher ALCO_Meszaros_85.tex

difficulty_reason: The result requires constructing the permutation-dependent tree and an explicit map from pipe-dream vertices to a canonical root-polytope triangulation. The nonroutine core proves that this map is a facet bijection through fixed-elbow/cross reductions and induction on the columns of the dominant permutation diagram. Ordinary prerequisites about simplicial complexes and root polytopes do not provide this construction; the entire authored bijection and induction remain present, exceeding ordinary PhD qualification exercises.
